AWS provisioning via idempotent setup scripts. Two-layer privacy enforcement (adapter + server-side). Gated closure via aws-verify-live.sh.","successCriteria":["After running aws-setup-bucket.sh && aws-setup-lambda.sh against a configured AWS account, the following resources exist and pass an idempotency check: S3 bucket with lifecycle rule (90d Glacier IR), Lambda function with Function URL, IAM execution role (s3:PutObject only), Lambda reserved-concurrency cap, CloudWatch log group (7-day retention).","The Lambda Function URL accepts a canonical event JSON POST and persists it as an S3 object keyed ${client_id}/${YYYY-MM-DD}/${event_id}.jsonl. Verifiable by query-stats.sh roundtrip.","telemetry-emit.sh auto-populates all 11 common fields from environment + config, requiring only event-type-specific fields from the caller.","Privacy policy enforced at TWO layers: (a) telemetry-emit.sh strips cited_excerpt at adapter; (b) Lambda handler verifies server-side. Verifiable by emitting with client_id=test-host-project and confirming null cited_excerpt.","Failure of the telemetry endpoint never fails a caller: telemetry-emit.sh exits 0 (warning to stderr) even on 5xx, timeout, or DNS failure.","Canonical event schema documented at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-event-schema.md covering all 5 event types, 11 common fields, per-type fields, defaults, Privacy Disclosure section.","query-stats.sh provides 5 validation subcommands (roundtrip, counts, recent, missing, sizes) via AWS CLI + DuckDB with date-range partitioning. /dso:review-stats --source=central dispatches query-stats.sh.","reviewer-base.md schema includes optional rule_id field for findings (non-breaking).","During d2f9 sprint, after AWS provisioning, reviewer-dispatcher emits a real telemetry event to the deployed endpoint and event is observed landing in S3 before sprint close.","Before d2f9 sprint can be marked complete, deployed AWS infrastructure is verified live via aws-verify-live.sh (7 checks: Lambda URL, IAM role, S3 bucket, S3 encryption, S3 lifecycle, Lambda\u2192S3 IAM permission, end-to-end healthcheck)."]},"researchFindings":[],"escalationPolicy":"Escalate when blocked","riskRegister":[{"risk":"AWS credential drift","mitigation":"aws-verify-live.sh gates closure; setup scripts re-runnable"},{"risk":"DuckDB not installed","mitigation":"Phase B story b386 verifies; aws-status.sh prerequisite check"},{"risk":"Privacy bypass via empty client_id","mitigation":"Empty client_id = hard exit 1 in telemetry-emit.sh"},{"risk":"Lambda cold-start latency","mitigation":"Accepted tradeoff; fail-open via || true"},{"risk":"Parallel adapter invocations racing on event-id-map.json","mitigation":"flock-based mutex"},{"risk":"DuckDB S3 scan latency growth","mitigation":"Date-range partitioning;
